title: The cleanup that deleted 883 Atlassian sites

segments.speaker: arjun
segments.text: Thirty sites. Old app gone. Everything else still works.

segments.speaker: maya
segments.text: You said that like you were about to close the ticket.

segments.speaker: arjun
segments.text: I was about to close my laptop.

segments.speaker: arjun
segments.text: Twenty-three minutes later, eight hundred and eighty-three Atlassian sites had been deleted.

segments.speaker: maya
segments.text: Sorry. Sites? I thought we were removing an app.

segments.speaker: arjun
segments.text: That's the part to look at. Same cleanup tool. Two different kinds of ID.

segments.speaker: arjun
segments.text: Give it an app ID, and it takes one thing out of the box.

segments.speaker: maya
segments.text: Give it a site ID, and it takes the box.

segments.speaker: arjun
segments.text: The first list pointed to the apps. The second list pointed to the sites.

segments.speaker: arjun
segments.text: The first clue came from a customer. The job was still running.
